text: SEMKIT-081: docs/plans/relate-phrases.md section 3 says prepositions, conjunctions and particles are dropped by the list stop/semtools, but that list lacks «под» (checked: 'под' not in wordlists.resolve('stop/semtools')), and the acceptance needs «под» dropped. The step drops a word by the part of speech of the bundled lemmatizer (prep, conj, prt), except the question words and --keep. The plan text can be updated to say so.
